recipes.name: Dessert Pizza
ingredients_raw: 1 (18 ounce) package refrigerated sugar cookie dough
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Press cookie dough evenly into a 12 inch pizza pan. Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown. Cool in pan on wire rack.
Spread whipped topping over cooled crust. Arrange fruit in a decorative pattern. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Dessert Pizza
raw_recipe.description: The crust is made from cookie dough and cooked until golden brown. The topping is a whipped topping and a swirl of fresh fruit slices -kiwi, strawberries or peaches.

review.reviewBody: When I made this I added a package of fat free cream cheese to with Fat Free cool whip and it thickened it and made it taste so much better. I used frozen fuit, raspberries and blueberries for the 4th and sprinkled coconuton top and it turned out great. Everyone at the party loved it. Freeze it for like a half an hour before serving and it is better.

Lovely simple recipe. Instead of whipped cream, I use fat free cream cheese, 2/3 pkg, and fat free/sugar free vanilla yogurt, about 1 cup. Just tangy enough to compliment the sugar cookie dough. I also sprinkled brown sugar around the "crust" while baking, and would flatten down the middle while it was baking so it didn't get too big.

I also added 8 oz of soft cream cheese to the cool whip which gave it an using thicker consistency. I cut the cookie crust into pie wedges after it cooled before I added the cool whip and fruit. Easier to serve.

Delicious, super simple, and a guaranteed crowd pleaser. I was making it for 6 so I used 1/2 roll sugar cookie dough pressed into a 9 in cake pan. Try to make it even and leave a rim for the dough to expand. For the topping, I really wanted to avoid cream cheese yet wanted something more substantial so I used 1/2 c lowfat vanilla yogurt and whipped in 2 heaping spoonfuls of lite whipped topping until smooth. This was airy and creamy without being too sweet. I frosted the cookie and refrigerated overnight and the topping set up really well. I wouldn't put the fruit more than 4 hours before serving bc it can get soggy. I have requests to make this for future birthday parties now!

Excellent! I used a 9x13 cake pan for the crust (I was taking it out of the house and wanted an easy way to transport it) which used the entire tube of cookie dough. I also added about 5 oz. of low fat cream cheese to the low fat cool whip mixture. Then used cut up strawberries, blackberries, bananas (with pineapple juice mixed with them to keep them from browning) and pineapple pieces. Next time I will cut the pieces of the pizza before adding the fruit, because when I cut the pizza after adding the pieces fruit, it got all messed up and didn't look as pretty. This was really wonderful - thanks for the recipe.

This was Awesome I only used strawberries because that's all I had my husband wasn't to keen on it but everyone else LOVED IT!!!!all you do is take one of those chocolate chip cookie dough roll thing, roll it out flatten as thin as you can bake it then take and put in freezer for a little bit cool down but not all the way then you take package of cream cheese and 8oz, cool whip mix together than spread over cookie after; first cut cookie into pieces will make it easier to work with, than cut strawberries up then bananas add a little lemon juice on bananas to avoid turning brown , the combination of the chocolate, cream cheese, strawberries and bananas puts your taste buds on a frigin journey as Ashley my son's girlfriend says ,,,

Just made this with the kids. We made and decorated individual cookies. We used 8 oz. whipped topping with 6 oz. whipped cream cheese + 1 tsp sugar for the frosting...good consistency and great flavor. Topped with thin sliced fresh peaches, strawberries, kiwi, blueberries. Will make this again soon, especially because it's a recipe that's easy and fun for the kids to help with.
I used a dry mix of sugar cookie dough with 1 egg and 1/3 cup of butter. Poked holes in the dough before bakig with a fork. Baked 17 minutes. Turned out GREAT!

My husband and I loved this!! I did change up a few things. I used chocolate chip cookie dough because I prefer the taste. I baked it in a 9 x13 pan because I didn't have a pizza pan. Also, I added 4 oz. of cream cheese and a little bit of sugar to the whipped cream. I topped it with strawberries, blueberries, kiwi, and banana. It was delicious!

WOW - Amazing! Had to pull together a quick dessert and found this one. Didn't have a pizza pan, so I used the largest baking dish I had. I used everyone else's suggestion of mixing fat free whipped topping with fat free cream cheese and it worked beautifully. Fresh berries are really expensive right now, so I bought frozen pre-cut smoothie fruit pieces, thawed them, and just scattered them over the top of the "sauce". Omitted the bananas because they turned gooey when thawed. Sprinkled sweetened coconut shavings over the top and then drizzled with chocolate and caramel syrup. HUGE hit at the Father's Day BBQ!!

Winter Version!!! Put the crust on an actual pizza stone and when it is still warm add the "sauce", (I prefer the cream cheese/whipped cream version), then add apple pie filling on top...tastes even better in front of a fire!
Delicious and beautiful! My family really enjoyed this dessert.
really good, i recommend coating your fruit in sugar before putting it onto the cookie crust. be careful not to bake your crust for more than 20 minutes or it’ll be very hard to cut through or bite.
So easy and delicious. Added some cream cheese to the whipped cream, and used kiwis, strawberries, blueberries, bananas, and grapes.
This is a delicious recipe. I followed the recipe with only one change. I added cream cheese to my whipped cream
My family loved this!
I LOVED IT!!!!!! :)))
This was easy and tasted good!

Simplicity and perfection. There has not been a party we have gone to where this desert was not the first to be scarfed up, with rave comments. There is a reason the recipe is for two of them. It seems wherever you go, or even at home, you always want more of this dessert.

I used this recipe for a party and people loved it!
I used 5 oz. of soft cream cheese with the 8 oz. of lite whipped cream. I did not have an electric mixer so I had to mix it with a whisk. Even though I used soft cream cheese, it was hard to get the chunks out. I would recommend leaving the cream cheese out and letting it get to room temperature. 
Also, to make it more party friendly, I made sugar cookies and then decorated each cookie separately. It made it much easier to pick up.
